policy: A gate may be passed or waived only with non-sensitive evidence references and named review metadata.

gates.title: Staging HTTP, cache, compression, and proxy verification
gates.required_evidence: Record staging header checks for immutable assets, private API responses, ETag/304, CORS, Brotli or gzip, TLS, and reverse-proxy behavior.

gates.title: Production-like MySQL/MariaDB query plans
gates.required_evidence: Attach EXPLAIN ANALYZE evidence for chat previews, notifications, events, outbox, mobile-push, and the consent-filtered product analytics aggregates plus the online-DDL rollout plan.

gates.title: SMTP, Firebase, Stripe, and PayPal smoke tests
gates.required_evidence: Provide sandbox or staging delivery, webhook signature, idempotency, retry, and failure-path evidence for every enabled provider.

gates.title: External SLO dashboards and alerts
gates.required_evidence: Link privacy-safe dashboards and tested alerts for availability, API errors, latency, queues, webhooks, mail, push, and backups.

gates.title: Android and iOS real-device acceptance
gates.required_evidence: Attach signed-build or TestFlight evidence for login, logout, secure token restore, push, upload, deep links, RTL, and core workflows on real devices.

gates.title: Native-language and Arabic RTL review
gates.required_evidence: Record native DE/EN/FR/AR review, semantic back-translation, overflow checks, and Arabic RTL visual acceptance on critical routes including privacy consent and product analytics.

gates.title: Version-bound legal and privacy approval
gates.required_evidence: Record approval of provider identity, terms, privacy notices, separate product analytics consent/version, retention rules, and store privacy declarations for the exact release version.

gates.title: DSGVO DPIA and processing governance
gates.required_evidence: Provide the approved DPIA, records of processing, processor inventory, product analytics purpose/KPI and minimum-group approval, deletion/export exercises, purpose limits, and incident contacts.

gates.title: Independent penetration test
gates.required_evidence: Attach the independent web, API, mobile, authorization, upload, payment, and tenant-isolation assessment plus closure evidence for critical findings.

gates.title: Three-to-five-club pilot acceptance
gates.required_evidence: Record onboarding, migration, support, active-use, billing, training, and administration outcomes for three to five representative pilot clubs.
